Markets.title: Global Market: European shares edge lower as investors await Iran sanctions details
Markets.summary: European shares edged lower on Monday due to pressure on technology stocks and cautious investor sentiment. Markets are currently awaiting details on United States sanctions against Iran, upcoming earnings from Nvidia, and new insights regarding the Federal Reserve's interest rate outlook.

Markets.title: Markets brace for more hawkish ECB as energy risks threaten to keep inflation elevated
Markets.summary: Financial markets are pricing in a more hawkish European Central Bank due to geopolitical tensions, high energy costs, and low gas inventories keeping eurozone inflation elevated. Investors now anticipate further interest rate hikes through 2027 amid resilient economic activity and fading disinflationary forces.

Markets.title: Global Market: China’s property crisis deepens as Evergrande founder gets life sentence
Markets.summary: China's property crisis continues to weigh on economic growth despite the Evergrande founder receiving a life sentence. Falling home prices, weak sales, and developer debt are persisting and hurting household wealth and consumption.

Markets.title: Infosys, HCLTech, other IT stocks gain on Nvidia’s likely price hikes. Are AI bubble worries coming true?

Markets.title: Muthoot Finance, Manappuram Finance shares rally up to 11% in 4 days as gold crosses Rs 1.63 lakh
Markets.summary: Shares of gold loan companies like Muthoot Finance and Manappuram Finance rose up to 11% over four days as gold prices surpassed Rs 1.63 lakh. This stock rally was driven by climbing gold prices stemming from a weaker dollar, US Treasury liquidity support, and ongoing geopolitical tensions.
